headline: Approved Option 2 specifications with a pool for proposed new Wallingford High School; motion to add back pool and 17 classrooms failed.
summary: The meeting covered the proposed One New Wallingford High School project. Members approved Option 2 education specifications with a natatorium (pool), with 6 in favor, 1 opposed, and 1 abstaining. A motion to add back the pool and 17 classrooms failed, 4 to 5.
decisions: Approved consent agenda items 7.1-7.5, 7.8-7.13 and 7.15 unanimously.
Approved the Wallingford Public Schools enrollment projection study by MP Planning Group, 8 to 1.
Approved the geotechnical study by Langan for the proposed One New Wallingford High School site, 8 to 1.
Approved adding the Bylaw 9311 language on "Bonafide Emergencies" to the policy adoption section.
Approved the 2026-27 Superintendent's goals and evaluation unanimously.
Approved the leave of absence for Cristina Garbalosa-Mullins, without pay, from November 16, 2026 through December 23, 2026, unanimously.
Accepted the resignation of Sarah Babineau, effective November 4, 2026, unanimously.
Approved revising the authorized signers of the ED-099 Agreement for Child Nutrition Programs to Danielle Bellizzi and Carrie LaTorre, unanimously.
Failed to add back the pool (natatorium) and 17 classrooms to the education specifications for the proposed new Wallingford High School, 4 to 5.
Failed to table the Option 2 education specifications motion until the next meeting, 3 to 5.
Approved Option 2 education specifications with shared spaces and the natatorium (pool), with 6 in favor, 1 opposed, and 1 abstaining.
Approved amendments to the ASTE building educational specifications, 8 in favor and none opposed.
